events.title: Hotfix 0.25.1
events.summary: Hey Pioneers! Tiny fixes on this one, mainly been focused on finishing the last bits for the full game! If all goes to plan, we should have some bigger announcements and teasers tomorrow or the next day! AA 0.25.1 Change-list- Fixed a bug where the tool evolution wasn't showing up- Added a hint to the path in the cave sample area- Fixed the C4C video from continuing to play when ejected I'm running out of things to fix, send more if you find it! Thanks for playing, - Kyle Frost (Mahelyk)

events.title: Hotfix 0.22.4
events.summary: Hey Pioneers! Thanks to everyone who's played the demo, and everyone who has submitted any issues you've found! This change-list isn't massive, and that's good! There's not a ton to fix, and most of my efforts have been going to adding in the Localization system, which should be working relatively soon. Changes - Fixed some small holes in the map, for players who like to 100% clean the dirt- Added Window mode option to Video Settings. Borderless is now the default. This seems to fix quite a few

events.title: Hotfix 0.22.3
events.summary: Hey Pioneers! Some more small fixes and improvements today. I was able to find a bug that effects players using DX11 that prevented them from cleaning artifacts, that's the big one. There are also more options for performance for players on lower end systems! 0.22.3 changelist- Added a new song from our composer "A View Quite Nice"- Fixed the alert spam when backpack is full- Fixed a hardware issue with DX11 that caused artifacts to not be able to be cleaned- Added an OFF setting to Global Illum

events.title: Hotfix 0.21.1
events.summary: Hey Pioneers! Some more fixes. The two big ones should be fixing the dirt crumbs that can respawn sometimes, and the rare issue where artifacts can't be cleaned. If you still have any issues like these (or any other issies) let me know!
